page_title: BOL 0-0 PAR | Bologna v Parma 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Bologna take a short corner kick.
90+4' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
90+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Fabio Pecchia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mandela Keita (Parma) replacing Adrian Bernabe Garcia.
89' A substitution has been made. Dennis Man is replaced by Drissa Camara (Parma).
88' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
88' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
88' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
84' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
83' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
82' Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) commits a rough foul. Marco Di Bello stops the game and makes a call.

80' Santiago Castro (Bologna) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Zion Suzuki pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
78' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Juan Miranda (Bologna) replaces Charalampos Lykogiannis.
78' Substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) has come on for Dan Ndoye.
78' The rebound finds Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
74' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
73' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
72' Fabio Pecchia has decided to substitute Ange-Yoan Bonny and he is replaced by Valentin Mihaila (Parma).
72' Substitution. Gabriel Charpentier (Parma) in, Hernani out.
68' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' The resulting corner from Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is cleared by the defence.
65' The resulting corner from Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is cleared.
62' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Here is a change. Nikola Moro is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
57' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' Matteo Cancellieri goes off the pitch and Antoine Hainaut (Parma) comes on.
55' Charalampos Lykogiannis clips a neat ball into the box towards Santiago Castro (Bologna), whose header from the centre of the box goes narrowly over the crossbar.
54' Bologna are ruled offside.
52' The ref signals that VAR has overturned that yellow card and upgraded it to a straight red for Woyo Coulibaly (Parma). He’s got to go!
52' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Woyo Coulibaly (Parma)! Let's see what he decides.
51' Woyo Coulibaly (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Di Bello had an easy-decision to make.
49' Santiago Castro (Bologna) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
48' Marco Di Bello has a clear sight and sees a foul from Remo Freuler (Bologna).
47' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
46' The game is over for Michel Aebischer (Bologna). Giovanni Fabbian comes on for the second half.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Samuel Iling Junior has come on in place of Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
46' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
44' Martin Erlic (Bologna) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
43' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
41' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Simon Sohm (Parma).
35' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
32' The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
30' A dangerous towering header by Santiago Castro (Bologna) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
29' The linesman makes the right call and Bologna will have a corner.
27' Hernani (Parma) takes a short corner kick.
25' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bologna was in an offside position.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.
18' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Ange-Yoan Bonny (Parma) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
16' Parma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
14' Parma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
11' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
